description: Hi! I'm William. I am working on my data science degree at California Lutheran and have built a few projects on my own. I am interested in data analytics and machine learning, and I love hearing creative solutions to problems. I am looking forward with you to working with you.
summary: We developed an interactive analysis of corn and soybeans. This allows users to gain a deeper understanding of rotation strategies, access rainfall data, and better understand their soil. This enables farmers in both Iowa and Illinois to better understand what they might do to prepare for the upcoming seasons.
details: Our project works by allowing farmers easy access to crop yield and environmental factors in both Illinois and Iowa. This understanding of crop yields across their state, as well as data about their environment, will allow them to capitalize on the knowledge and make an informed decision, so they can better prepare for the climate next year. To make this project, we used Google Colab, RStudio, and GitHub to prepare the presentation. We also used Gemini to help fill in any coding knowledge we did not have ourselves. A challenge we had to overcome was how to deliver large amounts of data to farmers, and with our creative solution, they can have an interactive slideshow that can be downloaded to help them better visually understand their environment. During this project, we considered how farmers might need to access this in areas where connection to the internet would be nearly impossible. To work around this we made a small easily downloadable slide show that they would be able to access.
